description: This PHP class 'TemplateWrapper' in the Twig templating engine exposes template functionalities for userland, including rendering, block management, and source retrieval.

classes.name: TemplateWrapper
classes.description: A final class that wraps a Twig template for rendering and block management, exposing an API for userland interaction.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns an iterable stream of the template content, yielding from the template's 'yield' method.

methods.name: streamBlock
methods.description: Returns an iterable stream of a specific block within the template.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the template with the given context to a string.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the template with the given context, internally calling the 'display' method of the wrapped template.

methods.name: hasBlock
methods.description: Checks if a block with the given name exists within the template.

methods.name: getBlockNames
methods.description: Returns an array of block names defined in the template.

methods.name: renderBlock
methods.description: Renders a specific block within the template with the provided context combined with global variables.

methods.name: displayBlock
methods.description: Displays a specific block of the template, outputting data directly.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source context of the template, providing source code and metadata.

methods.name: getTemplateName
methods.description: Returns the name of the template.
